annotations.title: List content waiting for your approval

description:
[read-only] Content held for approval that waits on the account owner's decision, newest first: posts filed with publish `requiresApproval: true`, drafts submitted for review, and workflow runs parked at an approval gate. `kind` is "manual" or "workflow". With status "rejected" it lists rejected content instead, with the reviewer's reason (`note`, `reasonChips`), who rejected it and when. Needs the explicit `approve` scope (admin does not include it). Agency plan.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/approvals.)

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.
